name: Art Deco
what_it_means: Art Deco (1920s-30s) is symmetrical, geometric and glamorous: gold line work, sunbursts, fan shapes, stepped forms and tall condensed type on deep black, emerald or navy. It signals luxury, celebration and timeless craftsmanship.
signature_moves: Gold line ornaments, sunbursts, fans, chevrons
Deep jewel tones (black, emerald, navy) + gold
Framed panels with double gold borders
best_for: Hotels & bars, weddings, events & galas, premium spirits
prompt_template: B U I L D Y O U R U I R E P L A C E T H E [ B R A C K E T S ] ** Design an invitation-style landing page for [BAR / HOTEL / GALA] in Art Deco style. Deep emerald-black background (#0B1A17) with gold (#D4AF37) geometric line ornaments: a central sunburst fan, stepped ziggurat corners, chevrons and double-line frames. Strict symmetry. Headline in a tall, condensed geometric display font (Poiret One / Limelight) with wide letter-spacing; ivory body text (#F3E9D2). Gold outline buttons with stepped corners. Subtle shimmer on gold elements. No rounded UI, no drop shadows.
